title: Abigiya and the Little Star
style_block: soft hand-painted storybook illustration, warm gentle light, pastel colours, painterly texture
character: a young Ethiopian girl about 8 years old, dark hair in braids, a simple colourful dress; an older Ethiopian grandmother with grey hair and a white shawl

voice.style: calm, warm, natural Ethiopian Amharic storyteller

music.caption: gentle warm Ethiopian krar and soft ambient pad lullaby, peaceful bedtime story underscore, slow tempo, instrumental, no vocals, soft dynamics leaving space for voice narration

shots.narration: በድሮ ዘመን፣ አቢጊያ የተባለች ትንሽ ልጅ በኢትዮጵያ ውብ መንደር ትኖር ነበር።
shots.subtitle: Once upon a time, a little girl named Abigiya lived in a beautiful village in Ethiopia.
shots.picture: The village at dusk, small houses and hills in soft light.

shots.narration: በየምሽቱ በመስኮት አጠገብ ተቀምጣ የጨለማውን ሰማይ ከዋክብት ትመለከት ነበር።
shots.subtitle: Every night, she sat by the window and watched the stars in the dark sky.
shots.picture: Abigiya sits by her bedroom window, looking up at the night sky.

shots.narration: አንድ ምሽት፣ ከሁሉም ይበልጥ ደምቃ የምትታይ አንዲት ትንሽ ኮከብ አየች።
shots.subtitle: One night, she saw a small star shining brighter than all the others.
shots.picture: One star shining brighter than the rest over the hills.

shots.narration: ፈገግ ብላም በዝግታ፣ «እኔም ልክ እንዳንቺ ማብራት በቻልኩ» አለች።
shots.subtitle: She smiled and softly said, "I wish I could shine like you."
shots.picture: Abigiya smiles and speaks softly toward the star.

shots.narration: አጠገቧ የነበረችው አያቷ ሰምታት፣ «የኔ ውድ፣ ለምን ኮከብ መሆን ፈለግሽ?» ስትል ጠየቀቻት።
shots.subtitle: Her grandmother, sitting nearby, heard her and asked gently, "My dear, why did you want to be a star?"
shots.picture: Her grandmother sits nearby, looking at her with a gentle question.

shots.narration: አቢጊያም፣ «ከዋክብት ጨለማን ያበራሉ። ዓለምን የተሻለች ማድረግ እፈልጋለሁ» አለች።
shots.subtitle: Abigiya replied, "Stars bring light to the darkness. I want to make the world a better place."
Her grandmother smiled and took her hand.
shots.picture: Grandmother smiles and holds Abigiya's hand.

shots.narration: «አቢጊያ፣ ብርሃን ለማምጣት ኮከብ መሆን አያስፈልግሽም። ሰው ስትረጂ፣ ደግነት ስታካፍሊ ወይም ብቸኛ ለሆነ ተስፋ ስትሰጪ ልክ እንደዚያች ኮከብ ታበሪያለሽ» አሏት።
shots.subtitle: "Abigiya, you don't need to be a star to bring light. Every time you help someone, share kindness, or give hope to someone who is lonely, you shine just like that star."
shots.picture: Grandmother speaks, warm light around her, then a child helps an elderly neighbour through a doorway.
shots.reason: The main lesson of the story.

shots.subtitle: Abigiya looked up at the sky again.
shots.picture: Abigiya looks up at the sky once more.
shots.reason: A calm return to the stars.

shots.narration: ትንሽ ብርሃን እንኳን ለውጥ እንደሚያመጣ ተረዳች።
shots.subtitle: She understood that even a small light can make a difference.
shots.picture: Abigiya holds a small light, calm and understanding.

shots.narration: ከዚያ ምሽት ጀምሮ በሰዎች ሕይወት ትንሽ ብርሃን ለማምጣት ጣረች።
shots.subtitle: From that night on, she tried to bring a little light into people's lives.
shots.picture: Abigiya helps villagers in small ways, with lanterns and water.

shots.subtitle: Her grandmother saw this and named her "Kokobe."
shots.picture: Grandmother and Abigiya under the stars, the end card with 'Made with AI' added in code.
shots.reason: The closing image. The end card text is added in code, since AI-generated text tends to come out garbled.
